text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad, this is so fun! Let's make 
today full of excitement♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... thank you, Urara-chan. But Rice 
today, you see—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I was so sleepy this morning that I could 
barely get out of bed. And according to 
the forecast, it looks like it's about to 
rain..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even on my birthday, it's nothing but 
misfortune. So... Urara-chan, you 
shouldn't be hanging around someone like 
Rice...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! That's amazing, that's 
amazing!\nThat makes me soooo happy~!!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! The bed gives Rice-chan 
a big, warm huuug!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The raindrops come all the way down from 
the sky just to celebrate with Rice, after 
all♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!! Rice... is going to hug you...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! I'm not gonna be outdone by 
everyone else, I'm gonna celebrate 
Rice-chan waaaay more~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah...! Thank you. Thank you so 
much, Urara-chan...!!
